name: Queen's Pawn Opening
description: A flexible d4 opening course focused on center control, development, and transposition understanding.

branches.title: Main Line: Flexible e3 Setup
branches.description: Learn a calm d4 setup that can transpose into many queen-pawn openings.

moves.title: Start with d4
moves.explanation: Control e5 and c5. d4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Queen Pawn Opening stays flexible: build a healthy center, develop, castle, then decide whether c4 or e4 is best.

moves.title: Black develops
moves.explanation: Black controls e4 and d5. Nf6 develops a knight to f6. Developed pieces control central squares, help castling, and make future tactics possible without forcing anything too early.
